newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area on Wednesday and over the holiday on Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 200 slaughter heifers; 58,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 11,800 formulated and 300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Heifers Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 67.00.
Wk to Date: 58,100 Week Ago: 71,300 Year Ago: 96,000
